design_review: Independent design ACCEPT for linear consuming mount attempt/pending successor, explicit trusted provenance, no production completion constructor and borrowing accepted-record receipt.
behavior: Only checked actually attached root can mint a successor clone via open_tree; owning mountns userns relation checked using NS_GET_USERNS/NS_GET_NSTYPE and namespace identity
Incoming token consumed by direct move_mount in its actual owning user namespace; attached and detached mount IDs distinguished while original pinned root retains same dev/inode backing
Full reservation/root/index/predecessor and Execute operation bind each attempt; request retained guard includes full immutable ownership
No Clone/raw-FD source surface; setup namespace borrow belongs only to exclusive attempt; transfer consumes token on success or uncertain error
Authenticated bounded SCM_RIGHTS transfers install only prepaid finite rights; pending successor unusable until exact borrowing completion after actual reap/snapshot/record acceptance
No production quiescent-completion constructor; metadata cannot establish detached creation/history and does not replace trusted setup provenance

Actual fixed three-launch chain returns successor before ACK and fixed write; parent independently verifies prior bytes before ACK, reaps child, snapshots original FD and accepts record before next begin

Fixed-write test thread fchdir then retires setup/root/token/userns/control authority; FD1 redirected to devnull, close_range retires FD3+, capabilities and ambient cleared and NNP verified before relative write
Capability assertions concern fixed-write thread only; trusted libtest may retain privileged threads, so no process-wide/untrusted confinement claim
Actual foreign Host display tree remains unchanged across later attachments; index/predecessor/refusal/revocation checks and final native/backing/retained cleanup discriminate ownership
Retained-bank shortage at pending acceptance rejects with payload owner still armed, closes successor token/userns and returns all tested credits after final root release
